Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In the interest of not wasting bandwidth, I will hereafter not
post the errata lists except on the 1st of the month, and will not
be posting the Rules Outline at all.

The most current versions of any of the resources I maintain
are always available from my Jyhad page, and are available
via anonymous ftp (thanks to Alec Habig).

URLs:
http://www.math.sc.edu/~sjohnson/jyhad/reference.html
ftp://bigbang.astro.indiana.edu/pub/jyhad/
